# StPageFlip 2.0.7

Source: https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip
Pinned npm release: https://registry.npmjs.org/page-flip/-/page-flip-2.0.7.tgz
License: MIT, copyright 2020 Nodlik (see LICENSE).

The unmodified browser distribution is self-hosted. No CDN, analytics, or remote runtime request is required. Used by the children's ride-on catalog reader and the Mende workshop album reader. Original artwork and PDF remain separate, unchanged local assets.
